notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.96]
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings to all humans and androids!

Today I'm launching a new update for demo version.

The main feature of this update - [b]Workbench![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/3b9dfd4c3df8ea73499aac4b05af733f95c5fece.png"][/img]
Along with this, the following items were added - [b]Adamantite Bar | Orichalcum Bar | Mythril Bar | Palladium Bar | Tungsten Bar | Anthracite | Yellow Reagent | Purple Reagent | Green Reagent | Steel Bar | Metal Scrap.[/b]

Recipes have been added to the workbench - [b]Armor Plate | Adamantite Bar | Orichalcum Bar | Mythril Bar | Palladium Bar | Tungsten Bar | Steel Bar | Pistol Ammo | Small-Caliber Ammo | Buckshot | Rifle Ammo | Laser Ammo | Energy Ammo.

[/b]The [b]Fortune[/b] parameter has been significantly reworked.
The [b]Perception[/b] parameter has been slightly reworked.

Added [b]CAP[/b] to levels - max character level now - [b]20[/b].

Added [b]tooltips[/b] for [u]already equipped[/u] weapons in the inventory. Now you don't need to unequip the weapon to see the stats.

Now you get [b]experience[/b] for [u]digging up crystals[/u].
Now you get [b]experience[/b] for [u]opening chests[/u].

Improved the system of "[b]pushing" [/b]Rika away if she gets in the way.

Fixed [b]weapons sticking[/b] in inventory after unequipping.

The [b]loot system[/b] from [u]corpses[/u] has been reworked.

Fixed [b]mouse sensitivity[/b] settings.

Fixed [b]hitbox for interaction[/b] with Rika.

[b]Rewards in chests[/b] have been reworked.

Fixed [b]impossibility of finishing off[/b] when [u]the enemy is stunned[/u].

Rika can now [b]attack in melee[/b].

--------------------------------------

This update also introduces some more mini-content and fixes a lot of minor things.[/p][p]This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749000?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.95]
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings to all humans and androids![/p][p][/p][p]Today I'm launching a new update for demo version.
In this version I have unlocked new feature, with an eye to the future.

I am pleased to introduce - [b]Mining Tool[/b] & [b]Ability to dig up resources!
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/cf7da116b48868f4f8d7d78d9aba3485e9fa9b84.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/591be7ee94f2b8cc5779237967e72bce487b7d8c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/1b095d8a40cf9f2327ca919ae0953367d1c5882f.png"][/img]
This is a future-oriented feature that marks the addition of a third gameplay direction - [b]digging[/b] & [b]crafting[/b]. This will serve to deepen and expand the gameplay in the full version of the game.


This update also introduces some more mini-content and fixes a lot of minor things.[/p][p]This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749000?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.92]
notes.notes:
[p]Well, I'm releasing an update for the demo version. 
Let's go over the new features:

The first feature - [b]Full-fledged menu with language selection.
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/439499e4043d2ef5b81dc6a5d695a605f69b0823.png"][/img]Currently, only [u]two[/u] languages are supported. [b]English[/b] and [b]Russian[/b]. Keep that in mind.

The second feature - [b]New player movement system.

[/b]So, In the previous version, I wanted to see how the players would appreciate the slow and atmospheric movement of the player. The experiment was generally successful, but it was noticeable that over time such a character's speed began to burden the players. Now it's time to completely turn the system around! 

Basic movement:
[b]Walking[/b] ---> [u][b]Jogging

[/b][/u]In addition to this, a new mechanic was opened in the demo version - [b]SPRINT[/b].
Keep in mind that the duration of the [u]sprint[/u] is directly affected by the [u]Strength[/u].

Well, besides these two features, the update introduces some more additions and fixes to the game.

This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749000?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]
